protocol_status: frozen 2026-10-19 r2: same tasks/groups/network/budgets; provider outages scored over all arrivals; complete block retained before recovery pause
fixed_budget_definition: total accepted body-fetch attempts <= 2, failures and cancellations consume attempts

freeze_record.parameter_policy: No change from development defaults; not selected using full-controller ranking.
freeze_record.native_qa_role_limitation: Observed QA tool calls are Q1; independent synthetic Q0 evidence does not establish native Q0 coverage.
freeze_record.revision_reason: Separate ordinary provider task failures from integrity failures; prevent exclusion of arrived failures. No parameters selected by outcome ranking.

provider_failure_policy.ordinary_provider_failure: All arrived tasks remain in denominator; missing/invalid answers score zero. A 504 or unknown remote terminal alone does not invalidate measured block.
provider_failure_policy.stop_rule: Retain failed_closed: stop new provider calls after unknown terminal. Complete arrival cohort and measurements, save valid block, then pause before the next block.
provider_failure_policy.resume_rule: Explicit reviewed resume performs one same-model response probe; preserve completed block, do not rerun its tasks; retain unknown terminal/usage and failed attempt costs.
provider_failure_policy.invalid_block: Model identity mismatch, exhausted experiment call budget, invalid measurement, or controller/protocol violation remain invalid.
provider_failure_policy.prior_run: R1 retained for diagnosis; R2 starts all primary cells afresh, no R1 scores selected or imported.
